title: The expedition's personnel list for Base A, Port Burwell
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: A printed list of named flying personnel, the R.C.M.P. constable, storekeeper, cook and assistant cook posted to Base A, Port Burwell, for the 1927-28 expedition.
people: G. Black;A. Caggie;A. H. Warner;J. F. Riggs;Bulteel;James Murray;Romeo Lemieux;J. Dorey;James Dacey

title: Ice observations at Base B, Nottingham Island, November 1927
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: The opening page of Appendix 9, recording day by day ground and air-patrol ice observations at Base B, Nottingham Island, from the first floe ice on November 16, 1927 through a series of numbered reconnaissance patrols.

title: Monthly meteorological observations at Base B, November and December 1927
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: A table (Appendix 10) of daily air temperature, wind, barometer, ice thickness and remarks recorded at Base B, Nottingham Island, through the autumn freeze-up of 1927, with repeated notes of snow and drifting.

title: Monthly meteorological observations at Base C, Wakeham Bay, August and September 1927
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: A table (Appendix 10) of daily air and water temperature, wind, barometer and remarks recorded at Base C, Wakeham Bay, during the base's first weeks of operation in the summer and early autumn of 1927.

title: Base B: the camp and derrick, and a view across the inlet
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of Base B, Nottingham Island: the camp, temporary shack, derrick and men's dwelling along the shore, and a view from the far side of the inlet showing the blubber house and radio mast.

title: Base A: derricks on the flat, and a launch towing a loaded scow
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two photographs of Base A, Port Burwell: a derrick erected on a small flat near boulders that had to be cleared, and a general view of Mission Cove with a launch leaving under tow of a loaded scow.

title: Aerial ice photographs south-east of Nottingham Island, February 1928
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two air-to-ground reconnaissance photographs taken over Nottingham Bay and the headland to the west in February 1928, from about 1,500 feet, recording the winter ice field for the expedition's ice patrols.

title: An aircraft over lake ice near Nottingham Island, and drifting icebergs off Big Island
creator: Hudson Strait Expedition
description: Two aerial photographs from the winter patrols of 1928: an expedition aircraft over lake ice near Nottingham Island, and drifting icebergs photographed abeam Big Island in Hudson Strait.
